metadata.title: Deploy CVEX Protocol on Arbitrum One
metadata.description:
# Deploy CVEX Protocol on Arbitrum One
# Purpose

The purpose of this action is to initiate the launch of the CVEX Protocol efficiently and establish the necessary structure for its initial operations.

# Proposal Summary

This proposal seeks to empower designated wallets to deploy the CVEX Protocol and assume key operational roles during the initial phase of the DAO.

# Proposal Details

We propose to authorise the following wallet addresses

1\. Protocol Deployer: 0x2F85050d4515644a398c72Ca0eB2AfcE23f7086d Role: Deploy the CVEX Smart Contracts

2\. Protocol Upgrader: 0xF5B9d429D07DfD2BABa80b583834c32779948A3B Role: Manage upgrades to the CVEX Smart Contracts

3\. Protocol Operator: 0x3517F0cA55ee096218677a8ba105fFCC734c6c4C Role: Manage protocol configuration

# Next Steps

After successful protocol deployment and configuration new proposal should be submitted to confirm the authenticity of main CVEX smart contract on Arbitrum One by it's address.
